title: 0.2 UI requirement reconciliation proposal; no main-register mutation
method: Read-only comparison of all 43 frontend rows with their original main-register acceptance and the current core/operations maps; cited file existence and the UI map trace hashes were checked. No application source, main register or test result was changed.
merge_rules: For the 33 frontend-exclusive rows, use the proposed status/verified_behavior/remaining_acceptance/acceptance_limits within their stated scope while preserving all original identity and acceptance fields.

For the 10 overlaps, append supplemental behavior/evidence/limits only. Use the core/operations status and retain its full remaining_acceptance and limits; do not replace them with the earlier main-register values or UI observations.
Global acceptance limits below apply to every row. A verified_local status records named local behavior; it is not full external acceptance.
Retain historical evidence as historical. Do not add overlapping focused/browser checks to a backend unique-test count or equate audited states with unique requirements.
If a source map changes after this proposal, review its changed behavior and refresh the recorded map hashes before final reconciliation.
global_acceptance_limits: All current real service interactions use fresh isolated synthetic demo databases. Provider transmission is disabled.
No real customer/patient data, vendor invoice, merchant settlement, carrier transfer, platform send or live-provider qualification is represented.
Axe WCAG2A/AA and WCAG2.1AA-tag audits and selected keyboard checks are bounded evidence, not full accessibility conformance or physical assistive-technology testing.
Desktop Chromium viewport tests do not qualify physical mobile hardware, native WebView/OS storage, microphone/Bluetooth routes, background operation, signing or installed app behavior.
Parent-owned platform, native packaging, backend concurrency/security, supplier UAT, legal and clinical approvals retain separate evidence.
Historical v1 browser-audio/live transport reports remain history and are not included in the current totals.

Interrupted runs are retained separately: an undetermined local ECONNRESET during extensions, an obsolete release-test expectation for the old onboarding heading, and the setup contrast findings that led to the final three-color correction. Failed attempts are not counted as passing evidence; their resolutions link the named reruns.

The final five-label correction received four focused latency checks and a fresh seven-check release rerun. Other suites retain their original bundle/script hashes; the prior release report is archived and excluded from totals. Source-equivalence records distinguish the earlier three-color change from the final label-only change.

The immutable build record retains the detected stale repository-dist read and the initial system-Python launcher failure before any browser/API check. The accepted build and both successful suites used the verified capture and project virtual environment.
explicit_fixture_boundaries: Companion external-calendar response contract uses injected cached/unknown/verified records, not a live remote provider.
Companion non-demo metadata is a fixture; controlled cost 503 is followed by recovery from the actual local API.
Waitlist stale-policy 409 is deliberately injected for UI recovery; successful bookings use the actual local synthetic API.
Privacy notice race changes actual local policy and receives an actual 409; it is not an injected consent-error response.
RTC lifecycle uses explicit synthetic Room events/API fixtures. Actual network recovery remains partial.
